verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Lago integration that syncs invoices, payments, or recognition entries to QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or any other general ledger or ERP. The only related material is CSV export from revenue analytics, which is the manual workflow the story wants to avoid, and generic webhooks and API access, which are building blocks rather than an accounting sync. The axis clearly applies to a billing platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery
